user_problem: Template placeholders have unclear sources, conversions and missing-value behavior.
unique_output: Placeholder-to-supplied-source binding map with declared transforms, conflicts and unresolved values, not a filled or sent document.
required_input: Template placeholders, candidate source fields and explicit mapping/transform policies.
critical_rule: Similar field names do not prove equivalence; no source or transform may be invented.
nearest_existing_and_difference: dataset-field-dictionary-builder defines fields; this binds fields to template placeholders under explicit mapping rules.
acceptance_scenario: Template client_name maps explicitly to customer.display_name; invoice_date has no mapping and remains unknown rather than using today.
